narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Four times faster means four times the hours, so four hundred eighty hours.
<bookmark mark='why'/>Eigh faster machine cannot take longer than the slow pair of oxen.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Four times faster means one quarter of the time, so that slip is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 120 × 4 = 480 hours for the tractor; the tractor races past the oxen; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='c1'/>To check, the tractor time should be one quarter of the oxen time.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>One hundred twenty divided by four is thirty, so both answers agree.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the field; two check lines appear: tractor time = oxen time ÷ 4; 120 ÷ 4 = 30

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says four times faster means four times the hours, four hundred eighty hours. A faster tractor takes less time, one quarter of the oxen time, so the bubble is struck.
